summary: Build readiness matrices, succession plans, and leadership pipelines with practical tools. Enroll in intermediate training for HR and talent teams.
lede: Succession planning and leadership pipeline development provides a structured way to identify critical roles, assess successor readiness, and create targeted development pathways. It helps organizations improve role coverage, reduce vacancy risk, protect institutional knowledge, and address dependence on individual leaders. This course gives you practical methods for role criticality mapping, readiness scoring, talent segmentation, succession heat mapping, development planning, mentorship design, and dashboard reporting. You will build a succession matrix, development roadmap, and executive summary while learning to use tools such as the 9-Box Grid, SWOT analysis, talent calibration, HRIS-based talent data, and AI-supported people analytics workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who own or influence succession planning and leadership pipeline development across HR, talent, and business functions.
audience: Workforce Planning Analyst using talent data
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of HR processes, performance review cycles, and basic talent management concepts. Familiarity with workforce planning, competency frameworks, and employee development planning will help you move faster, but you do not need coding skills. A laptop is recommended for working with succession matrices, talent review templates, and dashboard exercises. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted talent analytics are covered at an operational application level, not a technical engineering level.
